what: Vertical-stack budgets for biomes/matronscoast (Matron's Coast / The Snail Coast, rmwvqchv37nh0): 4 station HTML pages (< 2.0 MB each via matronscoast.tex.js sidecar), max samplers <= 13, and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

matronscoast.html.why: Station 1 (skerry): Drowned 16-island skerry sound, KCOAST shores, cemented Coquina Conch-Middens, Skerry Megachitons & Yonni sealime reserve.

matronscoast-browsewood.html.why: Station 2 (browsewood): 2.2 m Browse-Line Snail Cathedral, opalescent Mucus Silver-Highways, gliding Matron's Tower-Snails & Sister-Cup sky-ponds.

matronscoast-kelpfront.html.why: Station 3 (kelpfront): Southern Kelp-Grazing Front where giant snails & Megachitons rasp back Farside alien landkelp holdfasts.

matronscoast-cloudslope.html.why: Station 4 (cloudslope): Upper +2,150 m Cfb cloud-rainforest, 6-step Shell-Cemented Tufa Cataract, Shag-Shell Mountain Snails & Painted Lantern-Snails.

*.why: Shared matronscoast.tex.js texture sidecar pack serving all four Matron's Coast station pages.
